svg.aria-label: LaTeX Objects for Obsidian: Vim text objects, jumps and edits for LaTeX. An animated editor shows ci& changing a matrix cell, da^ deleting an exponent, >, swapping a fraction's arguments, dim reaching maths from the line above, ]e jumping between environments and dsb removing a \left( \right) pair.
